layer1.name: RethinkDB
layer1.one_liner: An open-source distributed document database built for realtime apps.
layer1.description: A database with a push-based query model, so applications could subscribe to changes instead of polling. Open source core, with a planned commercial offering around hosting and support.
layer1.outcome_note: Shut down and later donated to the Linux Foundation. The founders' postmortem, "Why we failed", identifies chasing a developer market that does not pay, and competing on a metric users cared about less than they claimed.
